text:
aisha: Heads up — we need a new GPU node pool in us-central1 for the edge-infer jobs. Constraints: VPC egress IPs are limited (only 6 NAT IPs left), regional quota for A10G is low, and we need AZ affinity to keep p99 latency stable. Can someone help with quota + networking plan?

matt: Do we have target sizing? p95 nodes needed, burst pattern? Also can we fall back to cheaper cards (T4) if quota blocked? @lena FYI since this touches egress IPs. :thinking_face:

aisha: Expected steady-state is small (1-2 nodes) with spikes up to 5 during batch windows. Latency-sensitive models need the A10G memory and fp16 perf — T4s drop quality on 4k context. Prefer autoscale min=0 max=6, and prefer non-preemptible for warm cache.

jun: Quick check — project quotas for us-central1 (from gcloud):
```
$ gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=redwood-infer --format="value(quotas)"
quotas: GPU_A10G_CORE: limit=4, usage=0
quotas: NAT_IP_ADDRESSES: limit=8, usage=2
```
So A10G quota is 4 (we only get 4 GPUs total unless we request increase).

matt: Ok that means we can run at most 1 node with 4x A10G if each node has 4 GPUs, or multiple smaller configs. What's the preferred node flavor? A2-highgpu-1g vs a2-highgpu-4g?

aisha: Prefer a2-highgpu-1g (one GPU per node) to let autoscaler do fine-grained downscaling and keep warm caches via node pools per AZ. Want AZ spread: use nodeAffinity in deployment and nodeSelector to bind pods to nearest AZ.

diego: Network constraint — our NAT IP pool is shared across regions for this VPC. If we add 5 more nodes they'll need outbound egress for model downloads and health checks. We should either: 1) allocate more NAT IPs, 2) deploy nodes into a subnet with Cloud NAT reserved addresses, or 3) use Private Google Access for storage pulls to reduce NAT usage.

lena: I'll open a GCP quota request for A10G (+8 GPUs), and request extra NAT IPs for the VPC. I'll also ping infra-support channel for a temporary v4 egress pool. ETA for quota is usually 24-72 hours.

ops-bot: Quota request submitted (ticket: GCP-17291) — A10G +8, NAT_IP_ADDRESSES +6. Status: Pending.

matt: While we wait, can we prototype with mixed pool (A100 spot or a2-1g preemptible)? Also ensure cluster-autoscaler config will prefer A10G node pool, but fallback to T4 pool if capacity unavailable. Suggest adding node-pool labels:
```
nodePool: edge-a10g
labels:
  hw: a10g
  tier: edge
autoscaling:
  min: 0
  max: 6
```
and fallback pool: edge-t4 with cheaper preemptible nodes.

aisha: Good plan. But need to watch model quality when routing. We'll add a runtime check to route requests to quantized models on T4s. Also add pod tolerations and nodeAffinity so pods only land on correct pool.

jun: Cluster-autoscaler notes: set expander: least-waste and configure scale-down-delay to 5m for bursty jobs; 1 GPU-per-node helps CA empties nodes quicker. Also set resourceLimits to avoid CA bringing up huge nodes that exceed quota.

diego: For networking, add Cloud NAT rule in us-central1 with dedicated IPs for the edge subnet. I can provision a small NAT gateway that uses 6 reserved IPs — will need subnet and route changes. That will reduce cross-project conflicts.

lena: I'll coordinate with GCP support and Diego. Plan: 1) open quota (done), 2) create edge-a10g pool with 1 GPU/node, min 0 max 4 as test, 3) add fallback edge-t4 preemptible pool, 4) add Cloud NAT reserved IPs for the subnet, 5) monitor cost & p99.

matt: One last item — cost cap alert. Add billing alert for that nodepool tag so PMs get notified if cost > $X/day.

aisha: Thanks all. I'll put a PR with the nodepool spec and CA config. Quick example spec I'll include in PR: 
```
apiVersion: container.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1
kind: ContainerNodePool
metadata:
  name: edge-a10g
spec:
  autoscaling:
    minNodeCount: 0
    maxNodeCount: 4
  nodeConfig:
    machineType: a2-highgpu-1g
    accelerators:
    - acceleratorCount: 1
      acceleratorType: a2-highgpu-1g
    tags: [edge, gpu]
```
I'll mark the PR WIP until quotas and NAT are in place.

lena: Sounds good — I'll update ticket GCP-17291 with Diego's NAT plan and tag infra-ops.

ops-bot: Ticket GCP-17291 updated by lena.

matt: Thanks — keep us posted, we should be able to test rollout end of week if quotas approve. :rocket:
